question: An infinite ladder network is constructed as follows: starting from the input terminal, a resistor $R$ is connected in series to a junction (node). From this node, a resistor $2R$ is connected directly to the return (ground) line (shunt branch). The circuit then continues from the same node through another series resistor $R$ to the next node, where again a shunt resistor $2R$ is connected to ground. This repeating $(\text{series }R\;\text{then shunt }2R)$ pattern continues infinitely. Using self-similarity, determine the equivalent input resistance $R_{eq}$.
